title: Ability of Modulated Imaging and Laser Speckle Imaging to Determine Burn Wound Severity and Healing Potential
official: Ability of Modulated Imaging and Laser Speckle Imaging to Determine Burn Wound Severity and Healing Potential
summary: According to the National Burn Repository 2007, the most common type of burn injury is a partial thickness burns. The current standard of care for partial thickness burns is two weeks of topical therapy and wound care. Burns that do not heal within two weeks undergo surgical excision and skin grafting.

interventions.name: Modulated Imaging and Laser Speckle Imaging

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Male / female all age
2. Subjects is an inpatient or out patient with burn wound

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Subjects cannot lied flat and still for the duration of the imaging
2. Subjects pregnant.
